The wall has thickness — the cool grey wall top (x≈185–500, y≈390–420) sits at a visibly different value and hue from the warm timber-and-pin face band directly below it (y≈420–455), so you read a cap and a face rather than a single stripe. The rope-lashed timber bundle at (380–500, 590–640) is drawn from above with the rope wraps visible and a proper contact shadow, which is the one prop in the set that is both correctly projected and on-fiction for the orc repairs. The brazier at (575–625, 525–570) throws its own small warm pool onto the adjacent tiles, distinct from the figure's light.
seat.WORST_WHY: 2 has no light falloff at all — the frame is one uniform brightness from the figure at top centre (≈225,10) to the bottom-left corner. The floor (x≈50–250) is a single flat brown fill with 1–2 px dark and blue speckles scattered like confetti; no packed-earth or flagstone structure. The water (x≈250–370, y≈0–190) is a flat green with a few circular blobs and meets the floor along a dead-straight vertical edge at x≈250 with no bank, lip or wet edge. The wall tiles (left column x≈0–50, bottom band y≈195–288) are plain grey rectangles with two or three scratch marks each and no cap/face distinction. There is a small dark rectangle at bottom centre (≈160–185, 268–276) that reads as a missing tile. The bone scatter at (≈210–235, 110–125) is drawn at a finer pixel pitch than the tiles around it. It looks like a greybox pass with placeholder art.

panel.ruling: five seats; block only on strong-majority regression (>=4 of 5 rank below the reference); else install if exit met and plant caught. Rank-in-deck cannot resolve polish-sized deltas at a 40% flip rate. — Rafe, 2026-09-09
panel.law: a gate's binding term must have a measured noise floor and must never be a single sample. — Rafe, 2026-09-08

_what: THE ITEM'S OWN MEASURED EXIT — required by INSTALL-LATEST (Rafe, 2026-09-08).
A build installs because it DID THE THING IT SET OUT TO DO. The rank test only says
the doing cost nothing against the seeded reference; this says what was done. Without
it, 'not worse than the reference' would mean 'not different from it', and a round
that changed nothing would install as readily as one that fixed something.
Declared here per item, recorded into the verdict, re-checked at the gate. The gate
refuses a `met` with no measurement behind it.
